topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the final lecture of the course and outlines the learning objectives on cancer therapy approaches.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies and cytotoxic resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss standard modalities of cancer treatment and the general mechanisms underlying cytotoxic drug resistance.

topics.label: Exploiting intrinsic cancer vulnerabilities and synthetic lethality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore therapeutic strategies that exploit intrinsic molecular defects and pathway dependencies specific to cancer cells.

topics.label: Targeted kinase inhibitors and mechanisms of resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the development and therapeutic mechanisms of targeted kinase inhibitors alongside the molecular pathways driving resistance.

topics.label: Monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the design and therapeutic applications of monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates targeted to tumor surface proteins.

topics.label: Cancer immunotherapy and T-cell activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the evidence for immune surveillance and the strategies used to harness and engineer cytotoxic T cells against tumors.

topics.label: Therapeutic progress, ongoing challenges, and future perspectives
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics review the overall clinical progress and systemic challenges across cancer treatments while discussing future therapeutic paradigms.
